key.name: citylist
key.description: citylist: comma-separated manual city LocationIDs; index 0 is the last active manual city

key.name: autolocate
key.description: when true the current city is resolved by public IP; when false the current city is citylist[0]. shared by app and plasmoid

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: auto refresh interval in minutes, synced with menu setting

key.name: thememode
key.description: record theme mode.there's three mode.auto,lightonly and darkonly
